title: Triggering Waveforms via Event Bus
description: Build an event bus subscriber that listens for watchdog timeout tags and starts selective waveform capture only when the failure is near.

steps.title: Step 1: Inspect the Event Bus
steps.instructions: Open `testbench.sv` and locate the `debug_event_bus` plus the watchdog publisher that emits `WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT`.

steps.title: Step 2: Add the Subscriber
steps.instructions: Implement `waveform_trigger_sub` as a `uvm_subscriber#(debug_event)` and trigger waveform capture when the timeout tag appears.

steps.title: Step 3: Wire and Verify
steps.instructions: Connect the subscriber to the event bus, rerun, and confirm selective waveform capture starts only near the timeout.
